compute_camera_intrinsics: compute the pinhole camera intrinsic matrix and UV-one vector for a RealSense camera given height and width
load_trajectory_data: load RGB, depth, and odometry data for a trajectory index and compute an Open3D point cloud
visualize_point_cloud: visualize accumulated point clouds from saved robot trajectories using the Open3D dashboard viewer
review_load_data: review the load_data function that reads RGB images, depth arrays, and odometry JSON to produce a point cloud
refactor_compute_uvone: refactor the compute_uvone function to accept configurable camera intrinsic parameters instead of hardcoded RealSense values
